description: Order a QUICK Social Background Check on a creator — a one-shot, full-history brand-safety scan (hate / NSFW / violence / profanity / political / legal / substance / deceptive, etc.). This is SEPARATE from the CreatorScore trust score and from API credits: it's a flat $29.99 USD / €27.99 ONE-TIME charge paid via a Stripe Checkout LINK this tool returns — the brand opens the link and pays, then the scan starts automatically. Poll it with check_background_check. The Verified tier ($29.99) requires the creator's own OAuth consent and CANNOT be started here — tell the user to order Verified from the dashboard.

creator_name.description: Optional display name for the report.

platforms.description: Platforms to scan the creator's public history on (at least one).

name: start_background_check
